## Installation

To install `pkgtmp`:

```r
remotes::install_github("OJWatson/pkgtmp", upgrade = FALSE)
```

## No-DOI PDF recovery

The agent-identified PDF handoff is documented in
`data-raw/agent_identified_pdf_manifest.csv`. Run the local validation/report
step without Google Drive access:

```bash
Rscript data-raw/fetch_agent_identified_pdfs.R --dry-run
```

To download staged PDFs, provide `SYS_MCS_AGENT_PDF_SOURCE_FOLDER_ID` or
`SYS_MCS_AGENT_PDF_SOURCE_FOLDER_NAME` and run with `--run`. Syncing to a review
Drive folder is off unless `SYS_MCS_AGENT_PDF_ALLOW_DEST_UPLOAD=true` is set.
